# Nautical Dream

> Practical, independently edited boating guidance for destinations, ownership, safety, maintenance and marine equipment.

## Main sections

- [Home](https://nauticaldream.com/): Latest destination, gear and editorial guidance.
- [Boating library](https://nauticaldream.com/boating-library.html): Complete topic and field-guide index.
- [Destinations](https://nauticaldream.com/destinations.html): Northeast and coastal boating destinations.
- [Gear](https://nauticaldream.com/gear.html): Equipment and buying guidance.
- [Journal](https://nauticaldream.com/journal.html): Long-form reporting and seasonal planning.
- [Editorial standards](https://nauticaldream.com/editorial-team.html): Research, sourcing and corrections.
